s.note: Banana chunks in a light soda water batter, fried and drizzled with honey.
s.how: Whisk 100g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp cornflour, 1 tbsp caster sugar and a pinch of salt with 170ml cold soda water into a smooth batter. Cut 4 firm bananas into 4cm chunks. Heat oil to 180C. Dip the banana in batter and fry in batches for 2 to 3 minutes until golden. Drain on paper towel, drizzle with honey and scatter with 50g crushed roasted peanuts. Eat while hot.

s.n: Kevin's cheddar and pecan cheese ball
s.note: Sharp cheddar and cream cheese rolled in toasted pecans, Ritz crackers, the swankiest snack in town.
s.how: Sharp cheddar beaten with cream cheese, Dijon and smoked paprika, shaped into a ball, chilled and rolled in toasted pecans, with Ritz crackers. Beat 250g softened cream cheese with 200g finely grated sharp cheddar, 1 tsp Dijon mustard and half a tsp smoked paprika until smooth. Shape into a ball, wrap and chill 1 hour. Toast 80g chopped pecans in a dry pan for 4 minutes, cool, and roll the ball in them. Serve with crackers.

m.note: Buttermilk chicken fried crisp, flaky biscuits and honey butter, finger food for a crowd in capes.
m.how: Chicken thighs soaked in buttermilk, dredged in seasoned flour and fried crisp, with flaky buttermilk scone biscuits and honey butter. Soak 1kg chicken thigh pieces in 500ml buttermilk with 1 tsp salt for 2 hours. Mix 250g plain flour with 2 tsp sweet paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp pepper. Dredge the chicken and fry at 170°C for 12 minutes until golden and cooked through. Rub 80g cold butter into 300g self-raising flour, stir in 220ml buttermilk, pat out 3cm thick, cut 8 rounds and bake at 220°C for 14 minutes. Beat 60g soft butter with 2 tbsp honey.

w.note: Bananas split under vanilla ice cream and hot chocolate fudge.
w.how: Heat 150ml cream and pour over 150g chopped dark chocolate, stirring into hot fudge. Split 4 bananas lengthways into long dishes. Add three scoops of vanilla ice cream to each, pour over the fudge and top with whipped cream and a maraschino cherry.

d.note: Banana, vanilla ice cream, milk and caramel sauce, blended thick.
d.how: Blend 3 ripe bananas with 6 scoops vanilla ice cream, 400ml cold milk and 3 tbsp caramel sauce sauce until thick and smooth. Drizzle a little more caramel inside 4 tall glasses and pour in the shake. Top each with a swirl of whipped cream, a banana slice and a final drizzle of caramel. Serve with wide straws.
